## Specification

### Component: Multi-select

Pick several values. Chips in the field, a search input, and a listbox of checkbox options that stays open while picking. WAI-ARIA combobox with `aria-multiselectable` listbox. Reuses `components/select/listbox.tsx`.

#### Anatomy
```
<MultiSelect>                        context: values[], max, text, query, open, registry; hidden <input name> per value
  <MultiSelectInput>                 <InputGroup class="ui-multi-select-control">
    .ui-multi-select-chips
      .ui-multi-select-chip × n      label + remove button (aria-label "Remove <name>")
      .ui-multi-select-chip.ui-multi-select-more   "+n more"
      <input role="combobox" class="ui-multi-select-input">
    chevron button (.ui-input-action)
  <MultiSelectContent>               .ui-floating.ui-listbox anchored to the field
    .ui-multi-select-status          "n selected" (role=status) [of max] + "Clear all" button (outside the listbox)
    <div role="listbox" aria-multiselectable>
      <MultiSelectItem value />      .ui-option with .ui-option-box checkbox on the left
      <MultiSelectGroup> <MultiSelectEmpty> <MultiSelectLabel> <MultiSelectSeparator>
```

#### Props
- `MultiSelect`: `value` / `defaultValue` (`string[]`), `onValueChange`, `max`, `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `name`, `form`, `disabled`.
- `MultiSelectInput`: `size`, `maxChips` (default 3), `placeholder`, `groupClassName`, input props.
- `MultiSelectItem`: `value`, `disabled`, `textValue`.

#### Behaviour
- Choosing an option toggles it, clears the search text, keeps the list open and focus in the input.
- Values keep the order they were picked. Chips show up to `maxChips`; the rest collapse into a non-removable "+n more" pill.
- Backspace in an empty input removes the last value (including collapsed ones). A chip's x removes it; the input keeps focus.
- With `max`: once reached, unselected options become `aria-disabled` and are skipped by the keyboard; the status reads "n selected of max".
- Typing filters like Combobox (case and diacritic-insensitive, match highlighted, first match highlighted). Esc closes (and clears text); Esc closed clears text.
- Enter toggles the highlighted option and never submits the form while open. ArrowDown / ArrowUp open then move.
- "Clear all" empties the selection. The placeholder shows only while nothing is selected.
- `name` renders one `<input type="hidden" name value>` per value.

#### Visual rules
- Field: `InputGroup` surface; min-height = control height (32/36/44) and grows as chips wrap; padding 4px; chips 24px tall, `--radius-sm`, `--ui-secondary` fill, 14px text, 12px x icon in an 18px hit area.
- Focus-within or open: border `--ui-ring` and 3px ring at 25%. Invalid: `--ui-destructive`.
- Checkbox: 16px, 4px radius, 1px `--ui-border-strong`; selected fills `--ui-control-on` with a `--ui-control-glyph` check.
- Status row: 12px muted, bottom border, padding 8px 12px; "Clear all" is a 12px/500 text button.

#### Motion
- Chips `ui-pop-in` 150ms; list `ui-pop-in` / `ui-pop-out` 150 / 160ms; checkbox colour 150ms. Reduced motion keeps state changes.

#### Accessibility
- Input `role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`; listbox `aria-multiselectable`; options `aria-selected`.
- Chip remove buttons are labelled and outside the tab order (Backspace is the keyboard path).

#### Acceptance checks
- Selecting three people shows three chips; a fourth with `maxChips=3` shows "+1 more".
- Backspace removes the last value; max disables the rest; Clear all works.
- Hidden inputs match the values; Field label focuses the input.
- axe clean in light and dark.

### `ui/components/multi-select/multi-select.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useId,
  useRef,
  type ChangeEvent,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import { InputAction, InputGroup, type InputSize } from '../input';
import {
  ListboxContent,
  ListboxEmpty,
  ListboxGroup,
  ListboxLabel,
  ListboxOption,
  ListboxSeparator,
  getOptions,
  useActiveOption,
  useOptionRegistry,
  useRegisterOption,
  type ListboxContentProps,
  type ListboxOptionProps,
  type OpenIntent,
  type OptionRegistry,
} from '../select/listbox';
import { highlightMatch, matchesQuery, nodeText } from '../select/listbox-utils';

interface MultiSelectContextValue {
  values: string[];
  max: number | undefined;
  full: boolean;
  /** Text in the search input. */
  text: string;
  /** What filters the list (kept while closing so the list doesn't jump). */
  query: string;
  open: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  openWith: (intent: OpenIntent) => void;
  resolveOpen: () => void;
  cancel: () => void;
  toggle: (value: string) => void;
  remove: (value: string) => void;
  clear: () => void;
  typeInto: (text: string) => void;
  clearText: () => void;
  anchorRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  inputRef: RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>;
  listRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  listId: string;
  registry: OptionRegistry;
  activeId: string | null;
  activeRef: RefObject<string | null>;
  activate: (id: string | null, scroll?: boolean) => void;
  move: ReturnType<typeof useActiveOption>['move'];
}

const MultiSelectContext = createContext<MultiSelectContextValue | null>(null);

function useMultiSelectContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(MultiSelectContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <MultiSelect>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface MultiSelectProps {
  /** Controlled selected values. */
  value?: string[];
  /** Initial values when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string[];
  onValueChange?: (value: string[]) => void;
  /** Most values that can be selected. Other options turn disabled once reached. */
  max?: number;
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Submitted with the form: one hidden input per value, all under this name. */
  name?: string;
  form?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * MultiSelect — pick several values. Selected values show as removable chips
 * in the field; the list beside them filters as you type and keeps its options
 * checked (WAI-ARIA combobox with a multiselectable listbox).
 */
export function MultiSelect({
  value: valueProp,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  max,
  open: openProp,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  name,
  form,
  disabled = false,
  children,
}: MultiSelectProps) {
  const [values, setValues] = useControllableState<string[]>({
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? [],
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });
  const [open, setOpenState] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const [text, setText] = useControllableState<string>({ defaultValue: '' });
  const [query, setQuery] = useControllableState<string>({ defaultValue: '' });
  const id = useId();
  const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const registry = useOptionRegistry();
  const { activeId, activeRef, activate, move, highlight } = useActiveOption(listRef);
  const intent = useRef<OpenIntent>('selected');
  const full = max !== undefined && values.length >= max;

  const setOpen = useCallback(
    (next: boolean) => {
      setOpenState(next);
      if (!next) activate(null);
    },
    [setOpenState, activate],
  );

  const openWith = useCallback(
    (nextIntent: OpenIntent) => {
      intent.current = nextIntent;
      if (nextIntent !== 'none') setQuery('');
      setOpen(true);
    },
    [setOpen, setQuery],
  );

  const resolveOpen = useCallback(() => highlight(intent.current), [highlight]);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);
    setText('');
  }, [setOpen, setText]);

  const toggle = useCallback(
    (v: string) => {
      setValues((prev) => {
        if (prev.includes(v)) return prev.filter((x) => x !== v);
        if (max !== undefined && prev.length >= max) return prev;
        return [...prev, v];
      });
      setText('');
      setQuery('');
      inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    },
    [setValues, setText, setQuery, max],
  );

  const remove = useCallback((v: string) => setValues((prev) => prev.filter((x) => x !== v)), [setValues]);

  const clear = useCallback(() => {
    setValues([]);
    inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [setValues]);

  const typeInto = useCallback(
    (next: string) => {
      setText(next);
      setQuery(next);
      if (!open) {
        intent.current = 'none';
        setOpen(true);
      }
    },
    [setText, setQuery, open, setOpen],
  );

  const clearText = useCallback(() => {
    setText('');
    setQuery('');
  }, [setText, setQuery]);

  // While filtering, the first match is highlighted so Enter picks it
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !query.trim()) return;
    const first = getOptions(listRef.current)[0];
    activate(first?.id ?? null, true);
  }, [query, open]);

  return (
    <MultiSelectContext.Provider
      value={{
        values,
        max,
        full,
        text,
        query,
        open,
        disabled,
        setOpen,
        openWith,
        resolveOpen,
        cancel,
        toggle,
        remove,
        clear,
        typeInto,
        clearText,
        anchorRef,
        inputRef,
        listRef,
        listId: `${id}-list`,
        registry,
        activeId,
        activeRef,
        activate,
        move,
      }}
    >
      {children}
      {name &&
        values.map((v) => <input key={v} type="hidden" name={name} value={v} form={form} disabled={disabled} />)}
    </MultiSelectContext.Provider>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface MultiSelectInputProps
  extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'size' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'type' | 'role' | 'name'> {
  /** Height of one row: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: InputSize;
  /** Chips shown before the rest collapse into a “+n more” pill. Default 3. */
  maxChips?: number;
  /** Class for the bordered field around the chips and the input. */
  groupClassName?: string;
}

const keepFocus = (e: MouseEvent) => e.preventDefault();

/** The field: removable chips, a search input and a chevron. */
export const MultiSelectInput = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, MultiSelectInputProps>(function MultiSelectInput(
  {
    size = 'md',
    maxChips = 3,
    groupClassName,
    className,
    placeholder,
    id,
    required,
    disabled,
    onChange,
    onKeyDown,
    onBlur,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useMultiSelectContext('MultiSelectInput');
  const control = useFieldControl({
    id,
    required,
    disabled,
    'aria-describedby': props['aria-describedby'],
    'aria-invalid': props['aria-invalid'],
  });
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, ctx.inputRef);
  const isDisabled = Boolean(control.disabled || ctx.disabled);
  const invalid = control['aria-invalid'] === true || control['aria-invalid'] === 'true';
  const shown = ctx.values.slice(0, Math.max(0, maxChips));
  const hidden = ctx.values.length - shown.length;

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || isDisabled || e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (ctx.open) ctx.move('next');
        else ctx.openWith('selected-first');
        return;
      case 'ArrowUp':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (ctx.open) ctx.move('prev');
        else ctx.openWith('selected-last');
        return;
      case 'PageDown':
        if (ctx.open) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.move('pageDown');
        }
        return;
      case 'PageUp':
        if (ctx.open) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.move('pageUp');
        }
        return;
      case 'Enter':
        if (ctx.open) {
          // Never submit the form while the list is open
          e.preventDefault();
          if (ctx.activeRef.current) document.getElementById(ctx.activeRef.current)?.click();
        }
        return;
      case 'Escape':
        if (ctx.open) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.cancel();
        } else if (ctx.text) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.clearText();
        }
        return;
      case 'Backspace': {
        const last = ctx.values[ctx.values.length - 1];
        if (e.currentTarget.value === '' && last !== undefined) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.remove(last);
        }
        return;
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <InputGroup
      ref={ctx.anchorRef}
      size={size}
      className={cn('ui-multi-select-control', groupClassName)}
      data-invalid={invalid ? '' : undefined}
      data-disabled={isDisabled ? '' : undefined}
      data-state={ctx.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (isDisabled || ctx.open || (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) return;
        ctx.openWith('selected');
      }}
    >
      <div className="ui-multi-select-chips">
        {shown.map((v) => {
          const entry = ctx.registry.get(v);
          return (
            <span key={v} className="ui-multi-select-chip" data-value={v}>
              <span className="ui-multi-select-chip-label">{entry?.node ?? v}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                tabIndex={-1}
                disabled={isDisabled}
                aria-label={`Remove ${entry?.text || v}`}
                className="ui-multi-select-chip-remove"
                onMouseDown={keepFocus}
                onClick={() => {
                  ctx.remove(v);
                  ctx.inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
                }}
              >
                <Icon name="x" size={12} strokeWidth={2} />
              </button>
            </span>
          );
        })}
        {hidden > 0 && <span className="ui-multi-select-chip ui-multi-select-more">{`+${hidden} more`}</span>}
        <input
          {...props}
          ref={ref}
          id={control.id}
          role="combobox"
          autoComplete="off"
          autoCapitalize="off"
          spellCheck={false}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          aria-haspopup="listbox"
          aria-expanded={ctx.open}
          aria-controls={ctx.open ? ctx.listId : undefined}
          aria-activedescendant={ctx.open && ctx.activeId ? ctx.activeId : undefined}
          aria-describedby={control['aria-describedby']}
          aria-invalid={control['aria-invalid']}
          aria-required={control.required || undefined}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          placeholder={ctx.values.length ? undefined : placeholder}
          value={ctx.text}
          className={cn('ui-multi-select-input', className)}
          onChange={(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
            onChange?.(e);
            if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.typeInto(e.target.value);
          }}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            onBlur?.(e);
            if (ctx.open) ctx.cancel();
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <InputAction
        aria-label="Show options"
        aria-expanded={ctx.open}
        tabIndex={-1}
        disabled={isDisabled}
        onMouseDown={keepFocus}
        onClick={() => {
          ctx.inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          if (ctx.open) ctx.cancel();
          else ctx.openWith('selected');
        }}
      >
        <Icon name="chevron-down" className="ui-combobox-chevron" />
      </InputAction>
    </InputGroup>
  );
});

export interface MultiSelectContentProps
  extends Omit<ListboxContentProps, 'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'listId' | 'listRef' | 'onOpened' | 'multiselectable' | 'header'> {}

/** The floating list, with an “n selected” summary and a Clear all button above the options. */
export const MultiSelectContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, MultiSelectContentProps>(function MultiSelectContent(
  { 'aria-labelledby': labelledBy, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useMultiSelectContext('MultiSelectContent');
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, panelRef);
  const count = ctx.values.length;

  useDismiss(ctx.open, [panelRef, ctx.anchorRef], () => ctx.cancel(), { escape: false });

  const header =
    count > 0 || ctx.max !== undefined ? (
      <div className="ui-multi-select-status">
        <span role="status" className="ui-multi-select-count">
          {`${count} selected${ctx.max !== undefined ? ` of ${ctx.max}` : ''}`}
        </span>
        {count > 0 && (
          <button type="button" tabIndex={-1} className="ui-multi-select-clear" onClick={ctx.clear}>
            Clear all
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    ) : null;

  return (
    <ListboxContent
      ref={ref}
      open={ctx.open}
      anchorRef={ctx.anchorRef}
      listId={ctx.listId}
      listRef={ctx.listRef}
      multiselectable
      header={header}
      onOpened={ctx.resolveOpen}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy ?? (ctx.inputRef.current?.id || undefined)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface MultiSelectItemProps
  extends Omit<ListboxOptionProps, 'optionId' | 'selected' | 'highlighted' | 'onChoose' | 'onActivate' | 'value' | 'indicator'> {
  /** The value this option stands for. Must be unique and non-empty. */
  value: string;
  /** Plain text to filter and name the chip when `children` isn't text. */
  textValue?: string;
}

/** One option with a checkbox. Choosing it toggles the value and keeps the list open. */
export const MultiSelectItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, MultiSelectItemProps>(function MultiSelectItem(
  { value, disabled, textValue, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useMultiSelectContext('MultiSelectItem');
  const id = useId();
  const text = textValue ?? nodeText(children);
  useRegisterOption(ctx.registry, value, text, children, disabled);
  if (!matchesQuery(text, ctx.query)) return null;
  const selected = ctx.values.includes(value);
  return (
    <ListboxOption
      {...props}
      ref={ref}
      optionId={id}
      value={value}
      selected={selected}
      highlighted={ctx.activeId === id}
      disabled={disabled || (ctx.full && !selected)}
      indicator="checkbox"
      onChoose={() => ctx.toggle(value)}
      onActivate={() => ctx.activate(id)}
    >
      {typeof children === 'string' ? highlightMatch(children, ctx.query) : children}
    </ListboxOption>
  );
});

/** “No results” text; shows only while nothing matches. */
export const MultiSelectEmpty = ListboxEmpty;
/** A labelled set of options. Hides when none of its options match. */
export const MultiSelectGroup = ListboxGroup;
/** A group heading, as a child of <MultiSelectGroup>. */
export const MultiSelectLabel = ListboxLabel;
/** A divider between groups. */
export const MultiSelectSeparator = ListboxSeparator;
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

```ts
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/multi-select.css`

```css
/* Multi-select --------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-input-group ui-multi-select-control" data-state data-invalid data-disabled>
     <div class="ui-multi-select-chips">
       <span class="ui-multi-select-chip"><span class="ui-multi-select-chip-label"/>
          <button class="ui-multi-select-chip-remove" aria-label="Remove …"/></span>
       <span class="ui-multi-select-chip ui-multi-select-more">+2 more</span>
       <input class="ui-multi-select-input" role="combobox">
     </div>
     <button class="ui-input-action">chevron</button>
   </div>
   Floating list: shared .ui-listbox (select.css), options with .ui-option-box checkboxes.
   Above the list: .ui-multi-select-status > .ui-multi-select-count + .ui-multi-select-clear
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  /* The field grows with its chips: min-height instead of height */
  .ui-input-group.ui-multi-select-control {
    align-items: flex-start;
    height: auto;
    min-height: var(--ui-input-h, 2.25rem);
    cursor: text;
  }
  .ui-multi-select-control:focus-within,
  .ui-multi-select-control[data-state="open"] {
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-multi-select-control[data-invalid] { --ui-input-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-multi-select-control[data-invalid]:focus-within,
  .ui-multi-select-control[data-invalid][data-state="open"] {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-multi-select-control[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-multi-select-control > .ui-input-action { margin-block-start: 0.25rem; }

  .ui-multi-select-chips {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 0%;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0.25rem 0 0.25rem 0.375rem;
  }

  /* ---- Chips ----------------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-multi-select-chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 1.5rem;
    padding-inline: 0.5rem 0.1875rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: var(--ui-secondary);
    color: var(--ui-secondary-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: 1;
    animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-multi-select-more { padding-inline-end: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-multi-select-chip-label {
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-multi-select-chip-remove {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 1.125rem;
    height: 1.125rem;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-multi-select-chip-remove > svg { pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-multi-select-chip-remove:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-multi-select-chip-remove:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 12%, transparent);
      color: var(--ui-foreground);
    }
  }

  /* ---- Search input ---------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-multi-select-input {
    flex: 1 1 4rem;
    min-width: 4rem;
    height: calc(var(--ui-input-h, 2.25rem) - 0.5rem - 2px);
    padding: 0 0.25rem;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: inherit;
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-multi-select-input::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }
  .ui-multi-select-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* ---- List header ----------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-multi-select-status {
    display: flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin: -4px -4px 4px;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
  }
  .ui-multi-select-count { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .ui-multi-select-clear {
    padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-multi-select-clear:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-multi-select-clear:hover { background: var(--ui-accent); }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Team members** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/multi-select/team-members.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { MultiSelect, MultiSelectContent, MultiSelectEmpty, MultiSelectInput, MultiSelectItem } from '@/ui/components/multi-select';

const members = [
  ['ada', 'Ada Lovelace'],
  ['grace', 'Grace Hopper'],
  ['katherine', 'Katherine Johnson'],
  ['margaret', 'Margaret Hamilton'],
  ['hedy', 'Hedy Lamarr'],
  ['radia', 'Radia Perlman'],
  ['annie', 'Annie Easley'],
  ['mae', 'Mae Jemison'],
] as const;

export default function MultiSelectTeamMembers() {
  return (
    <Field className="w-full max-w-md">
      <Label>Reviewers</Label>
      <MultiSelect name="reviewers" defaultValue={['ada', 'grace']}>
        <MultiSelectInput placeholder="Add reviewers" />
        <MultiSelectContent>
          {members.map(([id, name]) => (
            <MultiSelectItem key={id} value={id}>
              {name}
            </MultiSelectItem>
          ))}
          <MultiSelectEmpty>No teammates match your search.</MultiSelectEmpty>
        </MultiSelectContent>
      </MultiSelect>
      <FieldHint>Reviewers are notified when the pull request opens.</FieldHint>
    </Field>
  );
}
```
